Generate a fractional sample of all datasets

Source: R/api.R
sim_population.Rd

Convenience wrapper around sim_export() that generates a percentage of the full CBS population for all datasets and writes parquet files in CBS VM-style folder layout. Supports multiple years in a single call.

Usage

sim_population(
  output_dir,
  fraction = 0.01,
  years = 2023L,
  seed = 42L,
  include_network = FALSE,
  datasets = NULL,
  col_select = NULL,
  force_resim = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

output_dir

Directory to write parquet files into.

fraction

Fraction of the full population to simulate (default 0.01 = 1%). Must be between 0 (exclusive) and 1 (inclusive).

years

Integer vector of simulation years (default 2023).

seed

RNG seed for reproducibility (default 42).

include_network

Logical; include network datasets (buren, collega, familie)? Default FALSE.

datasets

Optional character vector of dataset identifiers to include (e.g. c("woonbase", "rdw")). Default NULL exports all registered datasets. Takes precedence over include_network.

col_select

Optional named list passed to sim_export(). Keys are CBS file names (e.g. "WoonbasePopulatiePersonen", "RDWNPACT") and values are character vectors of column names. Key columns (RINPERSOON etc.) are always included automatically.

force_resim

Logical; if TRUE, wipe the output directory and regenerate everything from scratch. Default FALSE skips files that are already present in .sim_meta.yaml with matching columns, n, and seed.

verbose

Print progress summary (default TRUE).

Value

Invisibly, output_dir.

Details

Network datasets (buren, collega, familie) are excluded by default because they produce O(n * relations_per_person) rows and can be very large.
